subject.title: fix(onboarding): keep recommendations isolated by workspace

question: Should an existing singleton onboarding-recommendation record be preserved exclusively for the configured default workspace when `openclaw doctor --fix` migrates it?
rationale: The historical singleton record has no intrinsic workspace owner, so selecting the default workspace is a product and upgrade-policy choice rather than a result test coverage can determine.

options.title: Accept default-workspace ownership
options.body: Retain the proposed migration, preserving the legacy record for the configured default workspace while other workspaces start with isolated state.

options.title: Define another migration policy
options.body: Specify a different supported outcome for ambiguous legacy state and update the migration and regression coverage before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept default-workspace ownership
recommendation.body: Retain the proposed migration, preserving the legacy record for the configured default workspace while other workspaces start with isolated state.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor proposed the migration boundary and can clarify its intended upgrade semantics; final acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
